name: AppFlowy
hook: A local-first, AI-ready workspace with boards, tables, calendars, and documents where your data stays on your machine with zero cloud lock-in.
bullets: Rich-text document editor with block-based formatting and nested pages
Customizable databases: Grid, Kanban Board, and Calendar views
100% offline-first: stores data locally with optional self-hosted cloud sync
Cross-platform desktop and mobile support built on Flutter and Rust
benefits: No monthly subscriptions or paywalls on document blocks or file uploads
Lightning-fast performance and offline access powered by Rust and Flutter
Your private documents and notes never get scraped for proprietary AI training
Export your data anytime to standard formats like Markdown and JSON
setupSteps: Download AppFlowy for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, or iOS
Create your first workspace with local storage
Add notes, Kanban boards, or task trackers from built-in templates
Optionally connect to AppFlowy Cloud or self-host your own server for sync
details: AppFlowy is an open-source, local-first workspace designed as a private alternative to Notion. Built with Flutter on the frontend and Rust on the backend, AppFlowy offers native speed, responsive offline access, and complete data ownership. You can build comprehensive knowledge bases, manage project sprints with Kanban boards, organize relational databases, and write rich-text documents without worrying about cloud outages, subscription tiers, or corporate telemetry.
setup: App (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS) — installer, AppImage, or APK
